claims.text: Do ⍉use w an MAOI, or for 2 wks after stopping one
claims.quote: Do not use if you are now taking a prescription monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) (certain drugs for depression, psychiatric or emotional conditions, or Parkinson's disease), or for 2 weeks after stopping the MAOI drug.
